title: Four ways to sell: services, products, digital, content

sections.skill: Classify a business idea by how it sells

questions.prompt: Jada offers house cleaning for 30 dollars an hour. What kind of business is this?
questions.correct_answer: A service
questions.intro: Most small businesses sell in one of four ways. A SERVICE sells time and skill, such as cleaning or tutoring; the owner's hours are the limit. A PHYSICAL PRODUCT is an item someone makes or buys and then sells, which means stock, packaging and shipping. A DIGITAL PRODUCT is a file, course or app delivered online; one copy can be sold many times, but it needs support and updates. CONTENT, such as videos or newsletters, attracts an audience and earns through sponsors, ads, affiliates or the creator's own products.
questions.feedback: House cleaning sells time and skill, so it is a service.

sections.skill: Four ways to sell, made simple

questions.prompt: A customer receives a haircut. What do they get?

choices.text: Free videos paid for by sponsors

questions.correct_answer: Someone's time and skill
questions.intro: Ask one question: what does the customer get? If they get your time and skill, like a haircut, it is a service. If they get an item they can hold, like a mug, it is a physical product. If they get a file or online access, like an e-book or an app, it is a digital product. If people watch, read or listen for free and money comes from sponsors, ads, affiliates or the creator's own products, it is content.
questions.feedback: A haircut is a service.
